name: Diagnosis -Inma no Note-
source:
A school boy becomes the possessor of an old note called "Diagnosis". It is a note which changes your life as you want. To satisfy his twisted desire toward an beautiful girl Arai Misaki, he writes down his wishes. 

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE027071.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
一名男学生得到了一本名为《诊断》的旧笔记本。这本笔记可以按照持有者的愿望改变生活。为了满足自己对美少女新井美咲的扭曲欲望，他在笔记本上写下了愿望。

[来自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE027071.html]DLsite[/url]]
